script.opening: Morning — could I ask who I'd need to speak to about the business itself, rather than day-to-day? ... You don't know me, and I'll be straight with you — this is a cold call. Thirty seconds, and if it's no use I'll go away.
script.hook: I had a proper look for you online this morning — no website, no Google listing, nothing at all under Centre Plumbing & Heating. That's unusual for a shop in this part of London. Can I ask you something about that?
script.valueStatement: What I'd normally do is small and specific — one page with what you stock, your hours, a way to get in touch, and anything customers have said about you. But before any of that, I'd want to understand a bit more about how the business actually works day to day.
script.demoOffer: If it turns out there's something worth doing here, I'd suggest building a simple example first — no charge to look at it, and you decide from there. But the honest next step is just understanding your business a bit better first.
script.pricing: If we get that far, it's four hundred pounds, once — nothing monthly, no contract. But let's see if this is even the right fit first.
